email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Coordinator role for Benelux and the Nordics. Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I work at the intersection of SEO, content, web and AI, and I am eager to bring my hands-on approach to an international veterinary business.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I plan and deliver content, manage WordPress and Shopify sites, and coordinate with clients and teams across markets. I have built and optimised websites from the ground up, run technical SEO audits, and used analytics to track performance. My background includes front-end development for a healthcare application, giving me a solid understanding of digital products and customer experience.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I am comfortable working with multiple stakeholders. I would welcome the chance to support your regional marketing plans and events.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Coordinator position for Benelux and the Nordics. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and web development, I am drawn to your mission of improving veterinary care through technology and education. Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I am well-placed to support your regional activities and travel across the markets.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in planning and delivering marketing activities. I manage content for multiple client websites, coordinate with stakeholders, and use analytics to track performance. For example, I built and optimised mirook.com, implementing structured data and running technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. I also support e-commerce stores on Shopify and WordPress, ensuring content aligns with brand guidelines and commercial objectives.

My earlier role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor gave me insight into healthcare applications, which fuels my interest in the veterinary sector. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I am comfortable working across teams and countries. I am proactive, organised and eager to learn, and I thrive in fast-paced environments where attention to detail matters.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your regional marketing plans, events and campaigns. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
